label: 2027 Budget Priorities Framework: expenditure priorities (DBM)
title: Briefer on the 2027 Budget Priorities Framework (Expenditure Priorities), Department of Budget and Management

sections.heading: Guiding principle
sections.text: Guided by the Philippine Development Plan 2023–2028, the Administration of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. shall prioritize expenditures that are strategically aligned with the President's 8-Point Socioeconomic Agenda, AmBisyon Natin 2040, and the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda. Public investments will be channeled toward key priority sectors—particularly human capital development, food security, infrastructure, climate and disaster resilience, and digital transformation. To optimize available fiscal space for Fiscal Year (FY) 2027, the government will rationalize programs and projects to eliminate redundancies, enhance allocative efficiency, improve service delivery outcomes, and advance a more inclusive, resilient, and sustainable growth trajectory.

sections.heading: Human capital development
sections.text: Expand equitable access to quality education by promoting lifelong learning through a flexible, adaptive, and future-ready education system. Accelerate the implementation of the Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning (ARAL) Program and strengthen Early Childhood Care and Development (ECCD) services. Strengthen the Universal Health Care system through sustained investments in primary health care, promotion of preventive and healthy behaviors, and enhanced disease surveillance and preparedness. Integrate the Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) and Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS), alongside digital payments, to improve targeting efficiency and delivery mechanisms of social protection programs. Foster a dynamic, inclusive, and responsive labor market, while advancing digital upskilling and reskilling initiatives under the Trabaho Para sa Bayan (TPB) Plan 2025–2034.

sections.heading: Food security
sections.text: Prioritize climate-resilient and smart agriculture through the adoption of advanced technologies and data-driven farm management systems. Provide targeted support for infrastructure and mechanization anchored on evidence-based planning and integrated information systems. Strengthen Farm and Fisheries Clustering and Consolidation (F2C2) to enhance productivity and enable more inclusive participation across agricultural value chains. Expand capacity-building programs in agribusiness, digital agriculture, and other relevant technical competencies.

sections.heading: Infrastructure development
sections.text: Prioritize the timely implementation of Infrastructure Flagship Projects (IFPs) and ensure completion of high-impact ongoing infrastructure programs, projects, and activities. Proactively address implementation constraints and institutional bottlenecks to improve project execution rates. Mainstream climate resilience, sustainability, and disaster risk reduction measures in infrastructure planning and design. Leverage public-private partnerships (PPPs) and other innovative financing modalities to augment fiscal resources for infrastructure development.

sections.heading: Digitalization
sections.text: Harness digital technologies and interoperable platforms to enhance efficiency, transparency, and accessibility of public service delivery. Strengthen the eGovPH system to enable secure, integrated, and automated government transactions. Expand digital infrastructure through cost-efficient and scalable technologies, with priority given to unserved and underserved areas.

sections.heading: Environment, climate, and disaster resilience
sections.text: Scale up nature-based solutions and strengthen investments in coastal and marine ecosystem conservation. Enhance the forecasting and monitoring capabilities of the Department of Science and Technology-Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (DOST-PAGASA), including the establishment of sustainable and localized weather stations. Strengthen predictive analytics and early warning systems for extreme heat and other climate-related hazards.

sections.heading: Implementation of full devolution to LGUs
sections.text: Extend the transition period to ensure a calibrated and sustainable implementation of full devolution by FY 2027 for cities and FY 2028 for provinces and municipalities. Provide targeted capacity-building interventions and fiscal support, particularly for low-income and disadvantaged LGUs. Deepen intergovernmental coordination and institutional linkages to reinforce local autonomy and ensure effective service delivery at the local level.
